note: The extra-field length comes from the input archive header and becomes the signed budget for parsing nested extra records.
Each parsed extra-field header consumes bytes from the remaining budget and can drive it negative if the encoded lengths are inconsistent.
The code only caps the copy length, but it does not enforce that the declared owner-name length fits the fixed buffer before later writing the terminator.
When value_len exceeds the buffer size, name_len becomes OWNER_MAXNAMELEN and the NUL write lands one byte past namebuf.
